hints.title: Non Zero Digit Divisibility Condition
hints.text: A self-dividing number cannot contain the digit zero and must be divisible by every individual digit it contains. How can extracting digits one by one validate each candidate?

hints.title: Modulo Digit Extraction Invariant
hints.text: Repeatedly extracting num modulo 10 gives the last digit; if that digit is zero or does not evenly divide the original number, the candidate is invalid.

hints.title: Range Filter Procedure
hints.text: Iterate through all integers from left to right inclusive. For each integer, extract its digits using modulo ten and integer division by ten. If any digit is zero or original number modulo digit is non-zero, reject it. If all digits pass, append it to the result list.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log10 M) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Converting numbers to strings for each iteration allocates unnecessary string objects and slows down iteration.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct arithmetic digit extraction processes each number in O(log10 M) time where M is at most 10,000, using O(1) auxiliary memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should preserve the original number while extracting digits and handle the zero digit case immediately.
